公司簡介
Corporate Profile




                                                                                                       天津水西雲廬
                                                                                                       Tianjin Shuixi Yunlu




綠城中國控股有限公司是中國領先的優質房產品開發及生活綜合服務供應商，以優秀的產品質
量、獨特的建築美學、以人為本的服務保持行業引領地位。公司連續二十年榮獲「中國房地產百
強企業綜合實力TOP10」1 ，所進駐重點城市客戶滿意度連續十三年保持領先，蟬聯產品力測評榜
第一 2，並獲得「房地產開發企業交付能力TOP5」
                        「 房地產開發企業穩健經營TOP10」等榮譽。

Greentown China Holdings Limited is a leading quality property developer and an integrated living
service provider in China. It maintains a leadership position in the industry by virtue of the quality of
its properties, its unique architectural aesthetics, and its customer-centric services. The Company has
been awarded the “Top10 among 100 Chinese Real Estate Enterprises by Comprehensive Strength” 1
for 20 consecutive years and maintained a leading position in customer satisfaction in core cities in
which it operates for 13 consecutive years, and ranked first in the product strength assessment lists for
several consecutive years2 as well as having been awarded the honors of “Top5 Real Estate Enterprises
by Delivery Capacity” and “Top10 Real Estate Developers with Steady Operation”.

2023年，中國房地產行業持續深度調整，改善需求逐步釋放，但面對複雜的內外部形勢、分化加
劇的市場環境等諸多不確定性，行業復蘇的過程顯得較為漫長。

In 2023, the real estate industry in the PRC continued to experience deep adjustments with the
demand for improvement being gradually released. However, in face of many uncertainties such as
complex internal and external situation and intensified differentiation of the market environment, the
recovery process of the industry appears to be relatively long .

房地產行業從之前的「四個分化」，即市場的分    The real estate industry has shifted from the previous “Four Differentiations”
化、資源的分化、企業的分化、產品的分化，進    based on market, resource, enterprise and product differences, to a new phase
入新階段，呈現出「四個變化」：發展階段從增量   of “Four Transformations”: the development stage moving from expansion to
時代變為存量時代，供求關係從供不應求變為供    consolidation, the supply-demand balance shifting from scarcity to surplus,
大於求，市場結構從剛需為主變為改善為主，房    the market structure changing from basic needs to quality upgrades, and the
屋功能需求從金融屬性回歸居住屬性。中國居民    housing demand reverting from financial speculation to living use. With the
的房產消費習慣、行業經營模式、以及未來產品    profound changes in the real estate consumption habits of Chinese residents,
創新方向都在發生深刻的改變，房地產行業面臨    the operation model of the industry and the direction of product innovation in
的挑戰和破局機遇已超出行業自身，更是與中國    the future, the challenges and opportunities to break the deadlock faced by the
的人口、經濟、文化發展階段息息相關，需要企    real estate industry have gone beyond the industry itself. In particular, it is closely

                         in China, requiring enterprises to explore new vibrant models of the industry with

       獨立非執行董事的委任                           在評估獨立非執行董事人選是否適合時，提名委員會將審閱有關人選的
                                            履歷（包括其資格及可投入的時間），並考慮董事會的組成、董事的技能
                                            及經驗、董事會的獨立性及多元化的要求。另外，根據上市規則下的企
                                            業管治守則，若獨立非執行董事在任已過九年，其是否獲續任應以獨立
                                            決議案形式由股東審議通過，而董事會將在致股東的通函中說明為何認
                                            為該名董事仍屬獨立人士及應獲重選的原因。
       Appointment of independent           In assessing suitability of the candidates for independent non-executive
        non-executive Directors             Directors, the Nomination Committee will review their profiles, including
                                            their qualification and time commitment, having regard to the Board’s
                                            composition, the Directors’ skills and experience, the independence of
                                            the Board and the requirement of diversity. In addition, in accordance
                                            with the Corporate Governance Code under the Listing Rules, if an
                                            independent non-executive Director has served for more than nine
                                            years, such Director’s reappointment should be subject to a separate
                                            resolution to be approved by shareholders and the Board will state
                                            in a circular to shareholders why it believes that such Director is still
                                            independent and should be re-elected.


       獨立非執行董事的薪酬                           獨立非執行董事在適當情況下就其於董事會及董事委員會的職位收取固
                                            定袍金。獨立非執行董事均未持有根據本公司購股權計劃及股份激勵計
                                            劃而授出的購股權或激勵股份。
       Remuneration of independent          Independent non-executive Directors shall receive fixed fee(s) for their
        non-executive Directors             roles as members of the Board and Board committee(s) as appropriate.
                                            None of independent non-executive Directors holds share options or
                                            share awards granted under the Company’s Share Option Scheme and

合理保證為高水平的保證，但不能保證按照香港                            Reasonable assurance is a high level of assurance, but is not a guarantee that

陳述。錯誤陳述可由欺詐或錯誤引起，倘合理預                            misstatement when it exists. Misstatements can arise from fraud or error and

      已竣工投資物業的估值經考慮來自該等物                                  The valuation for completed investment properties was arrived at by
      業現有租約的資本化收入及復歸租約之潛                                  considering the capitalised income derived from the existing tenancies
      力，或參考相同地區及狀況的同類物業之                                  and the reversionary potential of the properties or, where appropriate, by
      市場交易價格資料（如適用）後釐定。                                   reference to market evidence of transaction prices for similar properties
                                                          in the same locations and conditions.


      在建投資物業估值乃參考相關市場上可得                                  The valuation for investment properties under construction was arrived
      之可比較售價後釐定，於估值日的估計完                                  at by making reference to comparable selling prices, as available in
      工建造成本及估計開發商利潤也考慮在內。                                 the relevant market. The estimated construction costs to complete the
                                                          development and estimated developer’s profits at the date of valuation
                                                          are also taken into account.


      估計租金價值及市場租金年增長率單獨大                                  A significant increase (decrease) in the estimated rental value and the
      幅增加（減少）將導致投資物業的公平值大                                 market rent growth rate per annum in isolation would result in a significant
      幅增加（減少）。長期空置率及貼現率單獨                                 increase (decrease) in the fair value of the investment properties. A
      大幅增加（減少）將導致投資物業的公平值                                 significant increase (decrease) in the long term vacancy rate and the
      大幅減少（增加）。一般而言，就估計租金                                 discount rate in isolation would result in a significant decrease (increase)
      價值作出的假設的變動會導致租金年增長                                  in the fair value of the investment properties. Generally, a change in
      率及貼現率出現類似方向變動及長期空置                                  the assumption made for the estimated rental value is accompanied
      率出現反向變動。                                            by a directionally similar change in the rent growth per annum and the
                                                          discount rate and an opposite change in the long term vacancy rate.

45.   退休福利計劃                         45.     Retirement Benefits Plans
      本集團在中國內地的附屬公司僱員屬政府                     The employees of the Group’s subsidiaries in Chinese Mainland are
      管理的國家退休福利計劃成員。該等附屬                     members of the state-managed retirement benefits schemes operated
      公司須將發薪的若干百分比向退休福利計                     by the government. These subsidiaries are required to contribute a
      劃供款，以為該等福利提供資金。本集團                     certain percentage of payroll costs to the retirement benefits schemes
      對退休福利計劃的唯一責任是作出所規定                     to fund the benefits. The only obligation of the Group with respect to the
      供款。                                    retirement benefits schemes is to make the specified contributions.

      全數擔保金額的最高金額。根據於報告期              arrangement for the full guaranteed amount if that amount is claimed
      末的預期，本集團認為很可能毋須根據安              by the counterparty to the guarantee. Based on expectations at the end
      排支付任何金額。然而，此項估計視乎交              of the reporting period, the Group considers that it is more likely than

      資本管理                            Capital management
      本集團管理其資金，以確保本集團旗下實              The Group manages its capital to ensure that entities in the Group will
      體將能持續經營，並同時通過優化債務及              be able to continue as a going concern while maximising the return to
      權益平衡使股東回報最大化。本集團整體              shareholders through the optimisation of the debt and equity balance.
      策略與上年度維持不變。                     The Group’s overall strategy remains unchanged from the prior year.


      本集團的資本結構包含淨債務，當中包括              The capital structure of the Group consists of net debt, which includes the
      附註32、33、34、35分別所披露的銀行及          bank and other borrowings disclosed in note 32, senior notes disclosed in
      其他借款、優先票據、公司債務工具、證              note 33, corporate debt instruments disclosed in note 34, receipts under
      券化安排的收款（扣除現金及現金等價物）             securitisation arrangements disclosed in note 35 (net of cash and cash
      及資本與儲備。                         equivalents), and capital and reserves.


      本公司董事定期審查資本結構。作為審查              The directors of the Company review the capital structure on a regular
      的一部分，董事考慮資本成本及與各類資              basis. As part of this review, the directors consider the cost of capital and
      本有關的風險。本集團將以支付股息、發              the risks associated with each class of capital. The Group will balance its
      行新股及股份回購、發行新公司債務工具              overall capital structure through the payment of dividends, new share
      或贖回現有債務方式，平衡其整體資本結              issues and share buy-backs as well as the issue of new corporate debt
      構。                              instruments or the redemption of existing debt.
